nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' set to DELOREAN in the constructor.
Public string state variable 'symbol' set to DLN in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 '_totalSupply' holding the total minted token amount.
Mapping balances: address => uint holding per-account token balances.
Nested mapping allowed: owner => spender => uint holding ERC20 allowances.
Constructor: initializes name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and credits msg.sender with the entire supply.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender and credits 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits 'from', reduces allowance and credits 'to'.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): requires b <= a then c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b with overflow require.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): requires b > 0 then c = a / b.
msg.sender used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender throughout the token contract.
Arithmetic addition c = a + b inside safeAdd (overflow checked by require).
Arithmetic subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub (underflow checked by require).
Arithmetic multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul.
Arithmetic division c = a / b inside safeDiv with zero-divisor require.
State write allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens in approve; allowance overwrite without zero-first pattern.
State write balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) in transfer.
State write balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) in transfer.
State write balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) in transferFrom.
State write allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) in transferFrom.
State write balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) in transferFrom.
Parameter 'spender' of approve(address spender, uint tokens).
Parameter 'tokens' of approve(address spender, uint tokens).
Parameter 'to' of transfer(address to, uint tokens).
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer(address to, uint tokens).
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf(address tokenOwner).
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender).
Parameter 'spender' of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender).
Parameter 'a' of safeAdd(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'b' of safeAdd(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'a' of safeSub(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'b' of safeSub(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'a' of safeMul(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'b' of safeMul(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'a' of safeDiv(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'b' of safeDiv(uint a, uint b).
Local return variable 'c' assigned a + b in safeAdd.
Local return variable 'c' assigned a - b in safeSub.
Local return variable 'c' assigned a * b in safeMul.
Local return variable 'c' assigned a / b in safeDiv.
Named return variable 'balance' returned by balanceOf.
Named return variable 'remaining' returned by allowance.
Named return variable 'success' returned by approve.
Named return variable 'success' returned by transfer.
Named return variable 'success' returned by transferFrom.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the 'name' state variable.
Constructor assigns the 'symbol' state variable.
Constructor assigns the 'decimals' state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed initial supply.
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
approve performs the allowance state write.
transfer performs the sender balance debit write.
transfer performs the recipient balance credit write.
transferFrom performs the 'from' balance debit write.
transferFrom performs the allowance deduction write.
transferFrom performs the 'to' balance credit write.
safeAdd executes the unchecked-by-compiler addition c = a + b.
safeSub executes the subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul executes the multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv executes the division c = a / b.
transfer internally invokes safeSub for balance debits.
transfer internally invokes safeAdd for balance credits.
transferFrom internally invokes safeSub for debit and allowance update.
transferFrom internally invokes safeAdd for the recipient credit.
msg.sender is used as the key of the balances mapping in the constructor and transfer paths.
msg.sender acts as the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender acts as the spender key when deducting the allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender identifies whose balance is debited in transfer.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approve 'spender' parameter is the second index of the allowance write.
approve 'tokens' parameter is the value written into the allowance mapping.
transfer 'tokens' parameter is subtracted from balances[msg.sender].
transfer 'to' parameter is the key credited in balances[to].
transfer 'tokens' parameter is added to balances[to].
transferFrom 'from' parameter is the key debited in balances[from].
transferFrom 'tokens' parameter is subtracted from balances[from].
transferFrom 'from' parameter is the owner key of the allowance deduction.
transferFrom 'tokens' parameter is subtracted from the allowance.
transferFrom 'to' parameter is the key credited in balances[to].
transferFrom 'tokens' parameter is added to balances[to].
balanceOf 'tokenOwner' parameter indexes the balances mapping.
allowance 'tokenOwner' parameter is the outer key of the allowed mapping.
allowance 'spender' parameter is the inner key of the allowed mapping.
safeAdd operand 'a' flows into the addition.
safeAdd operand 'b' flows into the addition.
safeSub operand 'a' flows into the subtraction.
safeSub operand 'b' flows into the subtraction.
safeMul operand 'a' flows into the multiplication.
safeMul operand 'b' flows into the multiplication.
safeDiv operand 'a' flows into the division.
safeDiv operand 'b' flows into the division.
safeAdd result is stored in the local return variable c.
safeSub result is stored in the local return variable c.
safeMul result is stored in the local return variable c.
safeDiv result is stored in the local return variable c.
balances[tokenOwner] is returned through the local 'balance'.
allowed[tokenOwner][spender] is returned through the local 'remaining'.
approve returns true through the local 'success'.
transfer returns true through the local 'success'.
transferFrom returns true through the local 'success'.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'spender' parameter only flows into the allowance write in approve, so it normalizes into that unsafe operation.
The 'tokens' parameter is the allowance value written by approve, so it normalizes into that unsafe operation.
The 'to' parameter is only used as the credited balance key in transfer.
The 'tokens' parameter is the amount debited by transfer, so it normalizes into the debit operation.
The 'from' parameter is only used to index the debited balance in transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is only used as the credited balance key in transferFrom.
The 'tokens' parameter is the amount debited by transferFrom, so it folds into the debit operation.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter is only used to read a balance in balanceOf.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter is only used to read an allowance in allowance.
The 'spender' parameter is only used to read an allowance in allowance.
Operand 'a' flows exclusively into the safeAdd addition.
Operand 'b' flows exclusively into the safeAdd addition.
Operand 'a' flows exclusively into the safeSub subtraction.
Operand 'b' flows exclusively into the safeSub subtraction.
Operand 'a' flows exclusively into the safeMul multiplication.
Operand 'b' flows exclusively into the safeMul multiplication.
Operand 'a' flows exclusively into the safeDiv division.
Operand 'b' flows exclusively into the safeDiv division.
Local 'c' is just the result of the safeAdd addition.
Local 'c' is just the result of the safeSub subtraction.
Local 'c' is just the result of the safeMul multiplication.
Local 'c' is just the result of the safeDiv division.
Named return 'balance' carries the value read by balanceOf.
Named return 'remaining' carries the value read by allowance.
Named return 'success' represents the outcome of the approve allowance write.
Named return 'success' represents the outcome of the transfer balance writes.
Named return 'success' represents the outcome of the transferFrom balance writes.
